name: MATH-FIRST — Only Trade What Beats the House Edge

math.explanation: With 95% payout, you need >51.3% WR to profit. Every trade below that is guaranteed long-term loss.

CONTRACT_WHITELIST.description: Only trade contracts with proven >51.3% WR. DIGITDIFF is banned — 45% WR on 95% payout = guaranteed loss.
CONTRACT_WHITELIST.reason: All contracts pay 95% on win. DIGITDIFF 45% WR = -$0.10/trade. DIGITMATCH 45% WR = -$0.10/trade. Only PUT/CALL with >51.3% WR can profit.

MARKET_WHITELIST.description: Only trade markets where PUT/CALL strategies have proven profitable.
MARKET_WHITELIST.reason: R_75 FALL_TREND: 63.1% WR, +$12.73. JD100 FALL_TREND: 58.1% WR, +$13.51. JD25 has mixed results.

STRATEGY_WHITELIST.description: Only trade strategies with proven >51.3% WR AND positive PnL.
STRATEGY_WHITELIST.reason: Only these have beaten the house edge consistently.

STAKE_RULES.description: Flat staking. No escalation. Protect capital.
STAKE_RULES.reason: Stake escalation killed the account. Flat $1 until profitable for 7 days straight.

QUALITY_GATES.description: Only trade when ALL conditions are met.
QUALITY_GATES.reason: No trade unless we have mathematical edge.

KILL_SWITCHES.reason: If any of these trigger, stop trading immediately.

LEARNING_RULES.reason: Kill losers fast. Only retest if market conditions change.

targets.reason: Conservative. 5 trades × $0.95 × 55% WR = $2.61/day gross. After losses: ~$1.50/day.

banned_strategies.description: These are mathematically guaranteed to lose long-term.

DIGITDIFF.reason: 95% payout needs 51.3% WR. System achieves 45%. Guaranteed loss of $0.10/trade.

DIGITMATCH.reason: 95% payout needs 51.3% WR. System achieves 45.8%. Losing $0.12/trade.

DIGITODD.reason: 95% payout needs 51.3% WR. System achieves 35.5%. Losing $0.31/trade.

STAKE_ESCALATION.reason: Stakes ranged from $1 to $7.80. Higher stakes on losses = bigger losses.
